propositions: Core must compare only canonical (local-vocabulary) shapes; vendor shapes cross core solely as opaque payloads at emission and ingestion boundaries via port calls.

All transport construction sites and provider literals must route through the backend port abstraction; no direct adapters.jira imports or lazy-key literals in package-root core modules (except inbound_fields.py).
The 8 remaining Jira vendor modules must be physically relocated to adapters/jira/ with loaders repointed and no re-export shims.

Outbound field diff, link diff, absence probe, and rich-text/comment-limit paths must achieve parity with inbound_differ.py by canonicalizing via InboundMapper and building vendor payloads only via injected OutboundMapper.
Backend selection via config.reconciler.backend registry with default 'jira' must reproduce prior behavior end-to-end without vendor reach-through in core.
